decisions.reason: The shared treatment still requires a common footer and dark theme; changing the footer's specific background color does not alter those attributes.
Approval of the purple footer does not change the requirement for no header navigation.
The source approves the footer color specifically and does not change the landing page's broader visual-design attributes or hero background.
The footer color decision does not change the required token categories or documentation deliverables, and the candidate has no conflicting footer-color token.
The wizard's footer remains optional; approval of the shared website footer's color does not change the wizard-specific styling state.
The sign-in page's footer remains optional, and the source does not change its branding, background, or page-treatment requirements.
The footer background-color decision has no necessary effect on responsive rules, breakpoints, or layout behavior.
Although the message also discusses Console screenshots and buttons, the purple approval refers to the website footer and does not require the Console shell footer to become purple.
The footer color does not change the implementation stack, Astro decision, or handoff objective.
The website footer color has no necessary effect on Console or application navigation-panel structure.
